svg.title: Device onboarding
svg.desc: Backend-owned invite creation, identity guards, bootstrap artifact, agent/supervisor start, and first heartbeat.

stores invite/identity state (SQLite)

accepted enrollment (SQLite)
publishes (NATS)

starts/supervises (Local process)
React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
FastAPI /api/lite/*. Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.
Identity, authentication, and invite guards. Applies identity guards, duplicate checks, protected-host checks, and fail-closed invite/bootstrap acceptance.
Invite and identity lifecycle. Tracks pending, accepted, revoked, blocked, and consumed invite/identity state with duplicate and mismatch guards.
Enrollment and device lifecycle state. Retains enrolled devices across connectivity loss and separates durable enrollment, current state, health, supervisor state, and recovery history.
Lite node agent. Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.
Lite agent supervisor. Runs separately from the agent, reads the protected agent environment, and starts or restarts failed agents without overwriting identity.
Heartbeat, telemetry, and health publishers. Publish fresh runtime signals used to derive Online, Offline, Stale, Agent stopped, and Remote access not ready states.
Completion and audit evidence. Records sanitized lifecycle and completion evidence for commands, devices, apps, security, recovery, and releases.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.

a.xlink:title: PM2 process manager. Starts and supervises approved server-host and joined-device processes with bounded restart policies.
